source_evidence: You will not be able to sell your fund shares whenever you want.
question: Misconception: “I can sell all my interval fund shares whenever I choose.”
answer: Interval fund shares generally can be sold back only during periodic repurchase offers, often every three, six, or twelve months. The fund repurchases only a limited percentage of its outstanding shares, so you may not be able to sell all the shares you request in a given offer.
